title: Typed Data Attestation Request (.rwa/typed-data.json)
description: The Solana-bound auditor attestation request embedded in a .rwa package, matching signer/cmd/signer/typeddata.go's solanaTypedData struct and server/internal/auditpkg/typeddata.go's SolanaTypedDataDoc field-for-field. The server package-builder and the offline signer MUST agree on these field names byte-for-byte. cluster/program/config/vault are base58 Solana public keys/hashes, not 0x-hex; nonce is a 32-byte hex value (it seeds an on-chain replay-marker PDA verbatim), NOT a decimal counter; amount stays a decimal string (validated to fit uint64 in code, since Solana amounts are u64). For a MintAttestation, `message.recordId` is carried alongside `recordKey` so the signer can independently recompute recordKey = keccak256(bytes(recordId)). See shared/eip712/types.md.

_typeRules._comment: Conditional per primaryType (enforced in code — signer/cmd/signer/typeddata.go's parseSolanaTypedData — not by this schema's validators): MintAttestation message MUST include recordId + recordKey and MUST NOT include operationId; BurnAttestation message MUST include operationId and MUST NOT include recordId/recordKey.
